profile.headline: Principal Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Principal Software Engineer with over twelve years of experience creating high-quality digital products that customers love. I am an excellent communicator and leader, with a knack for turning complex problems into actionable steps. I am highly self-motivated, solution-oriented, and eager to step in wherever I am needed most to help a company scale and grow.

positions.title: Founding Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
“Empowering Families and Daycare Providers with Innovative Childcare Solutions”

• Came in early and built the business from zero to funding.
• Engineered a high-performance Python backend scaling to 10,000 RPS while sustaining sub-200 ms latency.
• Rebuilt and stabilized a React/Next.js frontend serving 750K+ MAU.
• Designed auto-scaling AWS infrastructure and one-click deployments (ELB, ECS, CI/CD, etc).
• Unblocked onboarding funnel bottlenecks, growing subscription ARR from $0 to $500K in 4 months.
• Leveraged user research, A/B testing, and SEO to grow YAU to 2M+.
• Built and led a high-performing engineering team.
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Python · User Research · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Elasticsearch · Project Management · Payment Systems · Product Management · Product Development · System Architecture

positions.title: Freelancer Developer and CTO
positions.description:
• Ramped down to help build Daycare.com
• Earned Upwork “Expert-Vetted” status (top 1%, pre-screened by Talent Managers and domain experts).
• Built end-to-end products with React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, LLMs/ML, and more.

Highlights:

• Infinity Loop Capitol
⁃ Long-term client
⁃ Built and shipped their iOS + Android app suite (500K+ MAU).
⁃ Optimized ad delivery with A/B tests + analytics, powering 40M+ monthly impressions.

• Genji
⁃ Built highly parallel AI/ML pipelines processing 100s of GBs of data.
⁃ Deployed GPU-powered cloud infrastructure to run an in-house LLM.
⁃ Applied techniques such as TF-IDF to parse gigabytes of messages into customer-relevant topics.
⁃ Created RAG agent generation systems tailored to user needs.

• Adaptify
⁃ Extracted competitor marketing intel using LLMs + robust XML parsing.
⁃ Designed LLM-driven branching logic for stronger social reasoning.
⁃ Wrote high-performing prompts that drove 150% traffic growth for customers.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Elasticsearch · Django · PostgreSQL · Large Language Models (LLM) · Objective-C · Swift · Meta AI (LLAMA) · Android Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform · User Research · Technical Leadership · Data Warehousing · Big Data

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
“A YC backed company, Precious is the iPhone app that uses AI to tell the story of your children growing up.”

• Built and maintained the iOS application and Python backend; served as lead backend developer for StyleMuse and lead developer for Hangout Games.
• Leveraged user research and rapid prototyping to scale subscriptions past 100K, generating over $6M in ARR.
• Led multiple high-impact projects, including a tool that reduced artwork turnaround time by 30× (from 60 minutes to 2 minutes).
• Contributed to the development of a state-of-the-art face identification ML model.
• Built an on-device ML image pipeline that processed a full photo library in under 30 minutes.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · User Research · iOS Development · Product Design · Objective-C · Swift · PostgreSQL · Unity3D · C# · Multiplayer · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Rapid Prototyping · Game Design · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Project Management · Product Development · Elasticsearch · Web Development · Virtual Reality (VR) · Fashion

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
"Kidjo is a subscription-based edutainment platform for kids. With over 4500 videos, audiobooks, and games, Kidjo delivers a complete, immersive experience across three dynamic apps."

• Shipped iOS, tvOS, Android, Android TV, web, and backend from zero → launch and beyond.
• Designed a horizontally scalable video pipeline (HLS/DASH, H.264/H.265) handling thousands of videos at once.
• Drove COPPA compliance across product and engineering.
• Sold (undisclosed).
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Android Development · iOS Development · docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Django · Python (Programming Language) · Elasticsearch · Web Development · Swift · Objective-C · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Freelance Developer and Consultant
positions.description:
"Working with Dakota has been quite an amazing experience. The client side of our application had to be taken over from a company who could not complete the work. He took on the huge task of tackling this transition. Here is why Dakota is the ideal person to hire:
- The quality of the work is amazing. He goes above and beyond what was asked and makes sure to bring up things that could make the project better
- He is very professional in giving constant updates and engaged in a lot of discussions to make the project the best possible
- His expertise is unmatched to all the developers I have worked with. He is very knowledgeable of mobile technology whether on the client side or the backend side of it.
- He is on top of things schedule wise giving regular updates on the milestones. There were so many unexpected things in this project and time and time again he was quick to adapt.

I am so happy Dakota has worked with us on this project. He is now my go to guy!"


"This guy is a winner. I hired Dakota to help code a iOS mobile app from the ground up, and he went beyond my expectations. He guided me through the entire process, answering my questions, making recommendations and getting this done way faster than I thought.

...
Communication- Him and I were communicating every single day throughout the project. Dakota made himself via phone calls, texts, e-mail, and skype/gchat. I was blown away by how much this contractor communicated during every aspect of the project. A+

High Quality- The code is rock solid. Don't be scared by this guy's lack of portfolio on elance, hes new and you'd be lucky to get him at this price. Not to mention hes been following up and fixing bugs if they rise up.

The guy works hard- I received roughly 80 bids for this project. He gave me the most realistic scope and time estimate by far. He then proceeded to get the project done in less time than he even quoted. This guy works his...."
positions.insights: Skills: Django · iOS Development · Unity · Kotlin · Python (Programming Language)
